**NCLEX-PN remediation CLI** — reads `seed/missed.json` (your missed-question journal: topics, client needs, why you missed them) and generates a 7-day study plan. Python-only, local JSON storage (editable on your phone), no database.

- **Python stdlib only** — no external dependencies, stays local
